description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/column_nonuniform_1d_tracer/rules/varcoeff_face_laplacian_lev_flux_bc_tracer and its disjointness from the 1-D rule grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/varcoeff_face_laplacian_lev_flux_bc, both imported by one model (the 1-D rule first, its free names rebound to w_kdudz_bot / w_kdudz_top): the compound D(K*D(u,lev),lev) on a [lev, tracer] state replaced by the tracer rule's body (the tracer frame: per-tracer interior stencil over [2,7] x [1,3]; per-tracer boundary layers at k=1 and k=8 reading the [tracer] free names kdudz_bot and kdudz_top; every interior flux the one interface_flux_K_lev_tracer template over the column grid's two-point law), and the same compound on a [lev] state w replaced by the 1-D rule's makearray -- each node lowered by exactly one rule, by its where shape. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLEV=8, NTRACER=3 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST in the esm-spec 9.6.4 reference-preserving form, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
